question: Mahatma Gandhi returned to Indian in January ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1915.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** returned to India in **January 1915.**
 
• He returned from** South Africa **where he had spent over two decades fighting for the** rights of Indians.**
 
• His return marked the beginning of his active involvement in the **Indian freedom struggle.**
 
• He played a key role in organizing various movements, including the** Non-cooperation Movement** and the **Salt Satyagraha, **which eventually led to India's independence from British rule.
 
• Gandhi's philosophy of** non-violent resistance, or Satyagraha,** inspired many leaders around the world, including **Martin Luther King Jr. and Nelson Mandela.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In** 1911**, Gandhi was still in South Africa and was actively involved in the Indian community's struggle for **civil rights.**
 
• In **1907**, Gandhi was still in South Africa and was leading the Indian community's resistance against the **discriminatory laws** imposed by the colonial government.
 
• In **1919**, Gandhi was already in India and was leading the **Non-cooperation Movement** against the British rule.
